name: raycast-command
title: Raycast Command
description: Frosted graphite command-palette ergonomics with keyboard-first focus, compact rows, crisp shortcut badges, and immediate feedback.

typography.fontFamily: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

rules: Design every workflow keyboard-first with visible selection, shortcuts, and predictable focus return.
Keep command rows compact, left-aligned, and built around one dominant action.
Use frosted graphite only for transient command surfaces with an opaque fallback.
Shortcut badges use monospace labels, subtle borders, and consistent key ordering.
Selection is communicated by surface and border as well as color.
Avoid decorative sidebar cards, marketing sections, and ambiguous icon-only commands.
Search feedback, empty states, errors, and loading states are designed as first-class rows.
Icons share one stroke, optical size, and alignment; never mix emoji with product iconography.
Focus and selection remain legible against every elevated graphite surface.
List motion is 120ms transform or opacity only and is removed under reduced motion.
